* **Rubrik (RBRK)** - KeyBanc raised its price target from $100.00 to $112.00 while maintaining an Overweight rating on August 21, 2026.

substack_outperformingmarket.summary:
* **NVIDIA (NVDA)** - Faces scrutiny over $500B in AI financing platforms while Bank of America highlighted a $2.3T hyperscaler backlog ahead of its Aug 26 Q2 earnings report.
* **Meta (META)** - Filed an appellate brief against FTC monopoly charges as a landmark trial regarding child privacy and addictive product design began in Oakland.
* **Snowflake (SNOW)** - Bank of America and Truist raised price targets to $395 and $375, respectively, following a $97.4M insider stock sale by Director Frank Slootman.
* **Alibaba (BABA)** - Reported Q1 revenue up 9% YoY to RMB 268.95B with Cloud surging 45%, though net income fell 76% due to heavy AI capex, drawing class action investigations alongside a maintained $180 PT from Morgan Stanley.
* **Amazon (AMZN)** - Posted Q2 2026 revenue of $200.6B with 36.7% AWS growth, raised its 2026 CapEx target to $220B, recorded a $53.4B gain from Anthropic, and hit a $25B run rate in custom chips.
* **TSMC (TSM)** - Raised its 2026 CapEx guidance to $60B–$64B ahead of the Hot Chips conference, with analysts predicting new all-time highs before year-end.
* **Microsoft (MSFT)** - Moody's affirmed its AAA credit rating amid focus on its $115.9B AI capex plan and Azure demand following a stock pullback from recent highs near $520.
* **Arm (ARM)** - Shares fell 3% to $243.32 as analysts noted its $25B revenue target requires substantial royalty expansion, while four Malaysian firms adopted its chip tech.
* **Rubrik (RBRK)** - KeyBanc raised its price target to $112 from $100 while maintaining an Overweight rating.
* **Zscaler (ZS)** - KeyBanc raised its price target to $210 from $185, while Deutsche Bank disclosed a new 382,183-share stake acquired in Q2.
* **ASML (ASML)** - Reports indicate a potential reprieve on US-China export restrictions, while Deutsche Bank cut its stake by 44% ahead of the Jefferies Tech Conference.
* **ACM Research (ACMR)** - CFO Mark McKechnie executed a $4.26M stock sale as analysts noted cash flow and margin volatility concerns despite upgraded 2026 revenue guidance.
